name: OpenMediaVault Self-Hosted NAS
free_limit: Free GPL-3.0 Debian-based NAS software with SMB/CIFS, SFTP, rsync and plugin-based storage administration; usable with your own disks without vendor storage quotas.
watch_out: Requires dedicated self-managed Debian host and physical/virtual disks; project expects exclusive control of OS configuration and cannot run in a container. Storage, backup hardware, electricity and maintenance are not included.
